description: Write the official report files for a stored failure analysis (from `failure_analysis`): Excel (`xlsx`), PDF (`pdf`) and/or HTML (`html`: the interactive HTML report, one self-contained page with summary, source-wise and issue-wise grouping, debugging information per failed test case and a link to the PDF when both are exported), plus `analysis.json`. Pass the `analysisId` it returned and the `format`. Optional filters (`suiteId`, `pattern`, `category`, `view`) are applied to every file. Files are saved under `outDir` (default ./qa-reports) and their paths returned. Protected test data is masked as ***. Optional `layout` reshapes the report to what the user asked for: `title`, `sections` (summary is always kept; order is fixed), test-case `columns` in the wanted order (keys: patternNo, source, code, name, iteration, failedStep, expected, actual, pattern, category, reason, lastPassed, failingSince, editedSincePass, report, screenshot, lastPassedScreenshot, baseline, reference, status, history, network; code is always included), `groupBy` (pattern | source | category), `sortBy` (pattern | code | failingSince | lastPassed | category), and up to 5 `extraColumns` ({ header, values: { "<test case code>": "<text>" }, default? }) — fill extra values only from evidence you reviewed. Counts and percentages are always computed by the server. Omit `layout` for the standard report; a custom layout gets its own file name.

format.description: Which files to write: any of "xlsx" (Excel workbook), "pdf", "html" (the interactive HTML report).

layout.description: Customise the report to the user request. Omit for the standard report.

columns.description: Test-case columns in the order wanted. "code" is always included.

extraColumns.description: Up to 5 AI-filled columns appended to the test-case table.

default.description: Text for test cases not in values. Default: blank.

sections.description: Sections to include: summary, rootCauses, sources, testCases. Summary is always kept and the order is always Summary, Root causes, Sources, Test cases.

sortBy.description: Sort rows inside each group (code breaks ties). lastPassed / failingSince sort by date, oldest first. Default: pattern.

name: failure_analysis_export
title: Export a failure analysis to Excel / PDF / HTML
